title: 奥德赛 · 第01集 v2：求婚者的狂宴（60s 写实漫画版）
what_if: 奥德修斯失踪20年，宫殿沦为求婚者的酒池肉林；19岁的忒勒玛科斯在怒火与无力之间，第一次看清自己将继承的是什么。
target_feeling: 史诗压迫感 + 漫画式愤怒 + 命运的冷光
visual_style: Realistic graphic novel style, dark fantasy comic: heavy ink shadows, crosshatching, detailed line work, deep black shadows, high contrast cinematic lighting, chiaroscuro, gritty comic book art, muted dark palette; Mycenaean Greece 1200 BC setting: cyclopean masonry, rough timber pillars, crude bronze vessels, coarse undyed linen and animal hides; 8k highly detailed

characters.name: Telemachus
characters.identity_note: male 19, lean wiry build, short messy dark-brown hair, sharp jaw, intense dark eyes; rough undyed wool tunic with frayed hem, bare arms, thin bronze armband on left wrist; do-not-change: face, short dark-brown hair, undyed wool tunic

characters.name: Penelope
characters.identity_note: female 34, oval face, long dark hair under a pale undyed wool veil, tall stoic figure; simple pale greyish-white wool chiton, plain bronze torc; do-not-change: face, veil, pale chiton

characters.name: Antinous
characters.identity_note: male 32, muscular build with a heavy flesh face, thick oiled dark beard, slicked-back black hair, cruel smug grin; heavy bronze-age jewelry: thick bronze torc and big ring; garish dyed-red tunic over fur; do-not-change: face, oiled beard, red tunic + bronze torc

scenes.name: Mycenaean Megaron (great hall)
scenes.description: massive interior palace hall: cyclopean stone walls, thick rough-hewn wooden pillars, central hearth pit, animal-skin floor with bones and spilled wine, drifting smoke haze, night
scenes.light_baseline: key: central hearth fire (warm orange) through smoke, heavy ink shadows, high contrast comic lighting

shots.continuity_handoff: Open on the smoky great hall; the suitors' feast is the baseline world; the toast shout sets up Antinous's cruel claim in the next shot.

char_positions.求婚者们(群演): dozens of bearded men in tunics sprawling on animal skins across the floor, midground

shots.lighting_baseline: key: central hearth fire warm orange through smoke; heavy ink shadows; high contrast comic lighting
shots.shot_description: Dark comic ink illustration: heavy ink shadows, crosshatched shading, deep black shadows, muted desaturated dark palette, no vibrant colors, no clean digital look. Wide shot, slow pan. Realistic graphic novel style. The smoky, dimly lit great hall of an ancient Greek palace. Dozens of arrogant bearded men in tunics feasting chaotically, spilling wine, and eating roasted meat. Thick wooden pillars, heavy ink shadows, high contrast cinematic lighting, gritty comic book art style, 8k resolution.

per_second.action: camera opens inside the smoky great hall; heavy ink shadows on the stone wall; fire flicker ripples across the haze
per_second.spatial: hearth center, wooden pillars left & right, animal skins and bones on the floor
per_second.audio: low roar of the fire + distant chaotic chatter

per_second.action: bearded suitors tear roasted meat with their hands, wine spills from tipped goblets, bones litter the skins
per_second.camera: slow pan continues across the hall
per_second.spatial: figures scattered across the midground, hearth glow central
per_second.audio: meat tearing + goblet clink + raucous laughter

per_second.action: one bearded suitor stands, raises his bronze goblet high above his head, shouts the first word of the toast
per_second.camera: pan settles on him at mid-right
per_second.spatial: goblet-raiser mid-right, hearth behind, crowd foreground
per_second.audio: Suitor A shouts: '干杯！'
per_second.handoff: the toast begins in the air

per_second.action: the crowd roars back, arms and goblets thrown up in the haze
per_second.spatial: same wide composition, cups raised everywhere
per_second.audio: Suitor A: '为了伊萨卡的无尽财富！' + crowd echo

per_second.action: the crowd toasts together, wine arcs through the air; the suitor's line lands and the laughter peaks
per_second.camera: slow pan drifts back to center
per_second.spatial: wide hall, fire glow center
per_second.audio: '为了我们未来的王后！' + peak roar + cup clink
per_second.handoff: end on the feast peak for the hard cut to Antinous's face

dialogue.text: 干杯！为了伊萨卡的无尽财富！为了我们未来的王后！

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT from the wide hall to Antinous's cruel face; same firelight world (stone wall + hearth glow); his blood-like dripping wine is the greed motif Telemachus watches next.

char_positions.Antinous: center close, facing camera, cruel grin

shots.lighting_baseline: key: hearth fire warm orange from front-left; deep black ink shadows; rim light on the dripping wine
shots.shot_description: Close up, slow motion. Realistic graphic novel style. A muscular, arrogant ancient Greek suitor with a thick beard and a cruel smile. He is raising a crude bronze goblet, dark red wine dripping down his beard like blood. Detailed line work, deep black shadows, chiaroscuro lighting, dark comic aesthetic.

per_second.action: Antinous leans into frame: heavy flesh face, thick oiled beard, cruel grin; the hall roar blurs behind him
per_second.spatial: his face center, dark stone wall behind, fire glow front-left
per_second.audio: his low chuckle + distant hall roar

per_second.action: he raises the crude bronze goblet to his lips, wine sloshing at the rim
per_second.spatial: goblet lower third, wine at the rim
per_second.audio: wine sloshing + his laugh grows

per_second.action: he drinks; dark red wine runs down his thick beard like blood, catching the firelight
per_second.camera: hold tight close on the dripping beard
per_second.spatial: wine stream down the beard center
per_second.audio: his line begins: '那个叫奥德修斯的老家伙早就死在海上了！'

per_second.action: he lowers the goblet, stares at camera, wine on his lips and beard; detailed ink line work on his cruel smile
per_second.spatial: his face center, goblet lowered to frame-bottom
per_second.audio: '这王座，这女人，都是我们的！' + his cruel laugh
per_second.handoff: the claim lands on his smile

per_second.action: he laughs, wiping wine from his chin with his thumb, pointing off-frame
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: his laugh + distant hall roar
per_second.handoff: end on the cruel smile for the hard cut to the shadow

dialogue.text: 那个叫奥德修斯的老家伙早就死在海上了！这王座，这女人，都是我们的！

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT to Telemachus in the pillar shadow; same hall (stone wall + hearth glow), his eye-line lands on the suitors; his suppressed whisper sets up the bone throw in the next shot.

char_positions.Telemachus: left third, midground, standing in the pillar shadow, facing frame-right

shots.lighting_baseline: key: hearth fire raking from the right, half his face lit; heavy crosshatched shadow on the other half
shots.shot_description: Medium shot. Realistic graphic novel style. Young Greek prince Telemachus standing in the dark shadows of a giant stone pillar. He looks at the suitors with intense anger. Firelight illuminates half of his face. Heavy contrast, crosshatching shading, glowing embers reflecting in his eyes, gritty realism.

per_second.action: Telemachus stands still in the pillar's shadow, jaw tight; firelight rakes the right half of his face; comic crosshatch shading deepens the left
per_second.spatial: pillar shadow at frame-left, Telemachus left third, fire glow right
per_second.audio: his controlled breathing + faint distant laughter

per_second.action: his eyes track the off-frame suitors; his jaw hardens; crosshatched shadow lines tighten on his neck
per_second.camera: slow tracking continues, slight push toward his eyes
per_second.spatial: fists at his sides lower third, eye-line frame-right
per_second.audio: breath-held tension, the hall roar pushed far

per_second.action: his fists clench; he mutters through gritted teeth, the first words landing soft and muffled
per_second.spatial: his face center-left, shadowed stone wall behind
per_second.audio: his muffled whisper: '寄生虫……'

per_second.action: his eyes glisten; a glowing ember reflects in his eye; the whisper continues
per_second.camera: hold, micro push to the eye
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: '在我的房子里，吃着我父亲的牛羊，却毫无敬畏。'

per_second.action: he swallows hard; one fist tightens further; smoke drifts past his silhouette
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: whisper ends, the hall roar returns faintly
per_second.handoff: holds his gaze for the hard cut to the bone throw

dialogue.text: 寄生虫……在我的房子里，吃着我父亲的牛羊，却毫无敬畏。

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT to the dynamic action beat: the bone lands where Telemachus stands; the jeer comes from the blurred background suitors; same hall world (stone floor + stone wall).
shots.lighting_baseline: harsh firelight from the left, deep ink shadows, action comic contrast
shots.shot_description: Dynamic action shot. Realistic graphic novel style. A large gnawed animal bone is thrown onto the stone floor in the foreground. In the blurred background, arrogant suitors are pointing and jeering maliciously. Action comic book layout, dramatic perspective, deep shadows, cinematic depth of field.

per_second.action: a large gnawed bone whips through the air with motion streaks, spinning toward the floor
per_second.spatial: bone mid-air center, stone floor below, blurred suitors far back
per_second.audio: the whoosh of the thrown bone

per_second.action: the bone slams onto the stone floor, spins, kicks up a puff of dust
per_second.camera: impact framing on the stone floor
per_second.spatial: bone foreground rolling, dust puff
per_second.audio: sharp clack of bone on stone + a hard thud

per_second.action: the camera pulls back fast: in the blurred background a suitor points at the shadows and jeers, the first words land
per_second.spatial: bone foreground-left, pointing suitor mid-right blurred
per_second.audio: Suitor B: '看呐！小王子在那儿偷看呢！'

per_second.action: the suitors in the background point and laugh, faces smug in the blur
per_second.spatial: bone foreground, laughing crowd background
per_second.audio: '怎么，你想替你那死鬼老爸出头吗？'

per_second.action: the laughter peaks, goblets raised in the blur; the bone comes to rest in the firelight
per_second.spatial: bone foreground center, fire glow catching it
per_second.audio: '哈哈哈哈！' + peak jeering
per_second.handoff: end on the jeer peak for the hard cut to the hand

dialogue.text: 看呐！小王子在那儿偷看呢！怎么，你想替你那死鬼老爸出头吗？哈哈哈哈！

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT to the extreme close-up: Telemachus's hand on the bronze dagger hilt (his identity carried by the frayed tunic sleeve + bronze armband, not the face); the scabbard creak and heartbeat carry his restraint; the loosening hand sets up the cut up to the balcony.
shots.lighting_baseline: harsh firelight raking the hand, deep ink shadow, high contrast on the bronze texture
shots.shot_description: Extreme close up. Realistic graphic novel style. A young man's hand violently gripping the hilt of an ancient bronze dagger. Veins popping on the hand. Harsh cinematic lighting highlighting the tension and the bronze texture. Intricate ink details, dark and gritty comic art.

per_second.action: a young man's hand slams onto the bronze dagger hilt, knuckles white; a frayed tunic sleeve and thin bronze armband mark the wrist
per_second.spatial: hand + hilt center, dark ink shadow background
per_second.audio: leather scabbard creak + the heartbeat begins low

per_second.action: the grip tightens, veins pop on the back of the hand; the bronze texture glints in the firelight
per_second.spatial: veins center, hilt lower
per_second.audio: heartbeat accelerates

per_second.action: the fingers strain; a trembling breath; the inner voice begins, soft and muffled
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: his inner monologue: '众神啊……如果你们还有眼'

per_second.action: the fingers start to slowly loosen, one by one; the hilt stays half-gripped
per_second.spatial: same composition
per_second.audio: '就降下惩罚吧。'

per_second.action: the hand rests half-open on the hilt; an ember swells, the ink shadows soften
per_second.spatial: hand + hilt center, ember glow at the edge
per_second.audio: '我还太弱小……' + heartbeat fades
per_second.handoff: end on the loosened hand for the hard cut up to the balcony

dialogue.text: 众神啊……如果你们还有眼，就降下惩罚吧。我还太弱小……
dialogue.tone: inner monologue, suppressed, trembling, voice over

shots.continuity_handoff: HARD CUT up to the wooden balcony: cold moonlight world against the warm firelight below; Penelope's veiled silhouette and her single tear are the closing image of the episode.

char_positions.Penelope: top center, veiled, standing at the rail, silhouetted against the moonlight

shots.lighting_baseline: key: pale cold moonlight from above; warm violent firelight glow from below; deep melancholic comic contrast
shots.shot_description: Low angle shot. Realistic graphic novel style. Queen Penelope wearing a veil, standing on a dark wooden balcony. A single tear rolls down her beautiful, sorrowful face as she looks down. Pale moonlight contrasting with warm firelight from below. Deep melancholic atmosphere, cinematic comic book framing.

per_second.action: camera looks up the rough stone wall to the dark wooden balcony; Penelope's veiled silhouette against the pale moon
per_second.spatial: stone wall bottom, wooden balcony top third, moonlight behind her
per_second.audio: night wind + the distant hall roar fading to a murmur
per_second.handoff: her silhouette resolves in the moonlight

per_second.action: she stands at the rail, veil half-shadowing her face, looking down over the chaos; warm firelight tints the frame bottom
per_second.camera: hold low angle on her silhouette
per_second.spatial: her silhouette top center, fire glow at frame bottom
per_second.audio: the roar recedes, a sad cello score begins to fade in

per_second.action: a single tear rolls down her cheek, catching the moonlight; her lips tremble; her line begins, soft and breaking
per_second.camera: slow push to her veiled face
per_second.spatial: tear line center on the cheek
per_second.audio: her soft whisper: '奥德修斯……你到底在哪里？' + cello swelling
per_second.handoff: the tear and the whisper land

per_second.action: she presses one hand to the rail; the tear trail glints; the cello rises under her voice
per_second.camera: hold on her face, low angle
per_second.spatial: hand on rail lower third, tear trail glowing
per_second.audio: '我们快撑不住了……' + cello sustained

per_second.action: she holds her stillness; cold moon above, warm fire below; heavy ink shadows close around her
per_second.camera: slow pull back to the full low-angle framing
per_second.spatial: silhouette top center, fire glow bottom edge
per_second.audio: cello sustains, night wind, the far-off fire
per_second.handoff: end on her silent grief - episode closes

dialogue.text: 奥德修斯……你到底在哪里？我们快撑不住了……
